frozen_intent: Pre-registration of Stage A no-selection diagnostics (0 trial). Any performance metric outside this pre-registered set counts as a trial. No config is selected in Stage A.

universe.label: KOSPI200_KOSDAQ150_intersection
universe.source: panel.rds (WT-D20260710_001 build_panel.R; base=tier_panel.parquet PIT-validated + load_month_factors augment)
universe.filter: in_univ==TRUE & not Admin/Halt (already applied in panel.rds)
universe.alignment_precheck: verify scores restricted to in_univ; per-month tier counts MEGA10/MID20 fixed; A2/A5 tier ranks recomputed within tradeable in_univ per Date

returns.per_stock: panel.rds Ret_1m (forward 1M realized, PIT: score at Date t known at t, Ret_1m is forward)
returns.benchmark: benchmark.parquet (KOSPI200 total return, BM_Ret daily) -> monthly compound expm1(sum(log1p)) -> forward-shift lead1 to align with grid Date holding month (canonical WT-001 convention)

factor_series_primary.name: value_innovation_age
factor_series_primary.rule: For a stock's cross-sectional z (zc_<axis>): a REFRESH at month t iff |z_t - z_{t-1}| > tau. Age_t = consecutive months (looking back only, PIT) since last refresh; first appearance => age 0 (fresh). Uses only past/current z, no forward info.
factor_series_primary.note: score_eff uses its own zc(score_eff); M08/V02 use zc_M08/zc_V02 from panel

dart_series.name: event_age
dart_series.rule: age = calendar months since most recent buyback decision disclosure (rcept_dt) with rcept_dt <= sig_date. Stocks with no prior event excluded from event-conditional analysis.
dart_series.note: sparse binary event is not a dense cross-sectional rank signal; A1 for DART reported as event-time forward-active mean by age bucket (event study), not universe rank-IC

A1.name: signal-age-resolved rank-IC decay curve
A1.metric: per series x age_bucket: Spearman rank-IC(score, forward Ret_1m) computed cross-sectionally per month within age bucket (require >=8 names), then mean across months + NW-t(lag3) of monthly IC series
A1.contrast: monthly paired IC_fresh(age<=1) - IC_stale(age>=4); mean + NW-t(lag3). Heterogeneity real iff contrast NW-t >= 2.0
A1.dart_variant: mean forward net-active return by event age bucket + NW-t; contrast fresh(0-1m) - stale(2-4m)
A1.lag_stress: recompute at lag1 (score_{t-1} -> Ret_1m_t) as PIT/robustness guard

A2.name: holding-age realized active decomposition
A2.book: canonical top-25 EW long-only from score_eff (canonical_screen_bt regime, 15bps, liq 2e8)
A2.holding_age: months since name entered current top-25 book (tenure)
A2.metric: monthly net active contribution split: fresh-held(entered<=2m) vs stale-held(>4m); paired NW-t(lag3) of monthly (fresh_active - stale_active). Dual basis: cap-w benchmark (KOSPI200) AND EW-universe benchmark

A3.name: cap-tier x age 2-way
A3.grid: tier{MEGA(1-10),MID(11-30),OTHER(31+)} x age_bucket; A1 rank-IC per cell (score_eff + M08 + V02) + fresh-alpha localization check
A3.kill_link: KA3: fresh-alpha only in OTHER/REST(>50) => time-axis trap reproduced

A4.name: economics pre-computation
A4.gross_spread: fresh-stale monthly gross spread from A1/A2 (annualized)
A4.cost: 15bps x 2 x incremental turnover implied by fresh-cohort rotation
A4.b2_expected_ir: Grinold IR = IC * sqrt(BR); BR = staggered independent bets/yr; compare to 0.63 threshold
A4.kill_link: KA4: economics below threshold => B2 blocked

A5.name: event x book census (counts, not backtest)
A5.a_veto: current book holdings x dilutive events (유상증자/CB) binding stock-months; threshold >=40. DATA: 유상증자/CB NOT in crawled DART (only 자기주식취득) => report 미가용
A5.b_promote: rank 21-40 boundary band (by score_eff) x fresh buyback event (age<=3m) binding stock-months; threshold >=60. window 2015+

A6.name: episode 3-regime book active (advisory only, NOT a gate)
A6.regimes: drawdown>=10% / recovery / normal (07-03 drawdown-lens on benchmark)
A6.metric: score_eff top-25 book net active decomposed by regime

kill_criteria_preregistered.KA1: A1 & A2 all-series contrast NW-t < 2.0 => 'signal slow enough for monthly grid; no sampling component' DISTILLED_NEG. (B1 may still enter via A5 census independently.)
kill_criteria_preregistered.KA3: fresh-alpha confined to REST(cap rank>50) only => time-axis cap-trap reproduced => terminate
kill_criteria_preregistered.KA5: census below threshold => B1 backtest 0 => terminate

integrity_checks.restatement_spotcheck: same (Date,Ticker) signal must not differ by build time: compare panel.rds zc_M08/zc_V02 vs FRESH load_month_factors(M08,V02) at >=3 spot dates via Spearman rank-cor (expect ~1.0 or ~-1.0; material deviation => restatement flag)
integrity_checks.asof_note: buyback rcept_dt PIT (disclosure date); factor scores sig_date-known; Ret_1m forward

no_selection_assertion: Stage A selects NO config. All numbers are diagnostic. 0 trials consumed.
